sentences.text: A survey of 7,569 human metagenomes found the gut symbiont Phascolarctobacterium faecium associated with non-obese adults regardless of nationality, sex or age.

In a mouse model of diet-induced obesity, the strain P. faecium DSM 32890 reversed the inflammatory phenotype associated with obesity and mitigated glucose intolerance, adiposity and body weight gain.
The same study reported that P. faecium promoted polarization of alternatively activated macrophages through TLR2 signalling.
A separate mouse study reported that daily administration of P. faecium reduced food intake through early overproduction of the satiety hormone peptide YY.
A 28-day oral toxicity study in rats and a pilot trial in 20 participants reported that P. faecium DSM 32890 did not raise safety concerns.
